jobs.description: Amazon Fuse — Business Development Role purpose: Own strategic partnerships that expand the distribution, acquisition, and engagement of Amazon subscription services through third-party partners. Fuse BD sits at the intersection of Amazon’s subscription services and major external distribution partners, creating commercial structures that embed Amazon services into products customers already buy and use. Core responsibilities Originate and own strategic partnerships with telecommunications operators, broadband providers, OEMs, financial institutions, retailers, and other large-scale distribution partners. Develop distribution strategies for Amazon services including Prime, Prime Video, Amazon Music, and other subscription products. Structure and negotiate complex commercial agreements - that solve unique problems - leveraging bundle structures, free trials, wholesale arrangements, fixed-fee structures, revenue shares, promotional offers, and/or embedded subscription models. You will own the full deal lifecycle. From identifying the right opportunity, to business case development through negotiation, contracting, launch, and ongoing commercial management. Build the business case and economics for partnerships, modeling customer acquisition, conversion, engagement, retention, partner economics, and long-term value. Internally, you will work across Amazon organizations, coordinating with product, finance, legal, tax, marketing, operations, engineering, and the individual subscription businesses to develop and execute partnerships. Serve as the senior commercial relationship owner with partner executives, identifying opportunities to expand relationships across multiple Amazon businesses. Drive post-launch performance, using subscriber, engagement, conversion, and financial data to identify under performance and develop initiatives to accelerate adoption. Develop market and partner strategy, prioritizing the partners and distribution channels capable of generating meaningful subscriber scale. Create repeatable partnership models that can be deployed across partners and markets rather than treating every agreement as a standalone transaction. Navigate highly complex organizations, aligning Amazon and partner stakeholders whose objectives, economics, technical requirements, and timelines may differ. Represent Amazon in executive-level negotiations, balancing partner objectives with Amazon’s long-term customer and economic interests. What makes Fuse BD different from traditional BD? The role isn’t about signing partnerships or managing accounts. It’s about solving complex business problems forging close relationships with 3P partners, that amplify distribution + corporate development + product commercialization. A strong Fuse BD person essentially asks: How can we solve this unique Amazon problem through 3P assets, in a way that benefits both companies AND its joint customers? Key job responsibilities 1. Develop and execute distribution strategy — Identify where and how Amazon subscription services such as Prime, Prime Video and Amazon Music should be distributed through third-party partners. 2. Source and develop strategic partnerships — Build relationships with telcos, ISPs, OEMs and other large-scale consumer platforms that can materially expand Amazon’s reach. 3. Structure and negotiate complex deals — Lead commercial negotiations covering bundles, wholesale models, free trials, fixed fees, revenue shares, customer eligibility and other distribution constructs. 4. Own deals end-to-end — Take opportunities from initial concept and business case through internal approval, negotiation, contracting, technical integration and commercial launch. 5. Build business cases and evaluate economics — Assess subscriber potential, acquisition cost, conversion, engagement, retention and overall financial return to determine which opportunities Amazon should pursue. 6. Lead cross-functional execution — Coordinate across Prime, Prime Video, Amazon Music, Finance, Legal, Tax, Product, Marketing, Engineering and Operations to get deals approved and launched. 7. Manage senior partner relationships — Serve as Amazon’s commercial owner with senior executives at strategic partners and expand relationships beyond individual transactions. 8. Drive post-launch performance and growth — Track subscriber acquisition, activation, engagement and economics; identify gaps and work with partners and Amazon teams to improve performance. 9. Create scalable partnership models — Turn successful deals into repeatable commercial and technical frameworks that can be deployed across additional partners, products and markets. 10. Own market/portfolio priorities — Determine where BD resources should be deployed based on partner scale, customer reach, strategic importance and expected economic impact

jobs.description: Our mission is to automate coding. The first step in our journey is to build the best tool for professional programmers, using a combination of inventive research, design, and engineering. Our organization is very flat, and our team is small and talent dense. We particularly like people who are truth-seeking, passionate, and creative. We enjoy spirited debate, crazy ideas, and shipping code. About the role We're building a Forward Deployed Engineering team to close the gap between the value our enterprise customers expect from Cursor and the value they're actually getting. FDEs don't advise, they embed directly with customer engineering teams, build production-grade Cursor workflows, and transfer the habits and culture that compound long after the engagement ends. The measure of success is what's different at day 30, not what got shipped. We're looking for a RVP, Forward Deployed Engineering to lead and help scale this team. You'll manage a growing team of FDEs working across our most strategic enterprise accounts, own what makes a world-class FDE engagement, and stay close enough to the work to escalate, coach, and course-correct in real time. You will serve as the primary point of contact for customers, owning both project delivery and the day-to-day relationship, while also identifying and scoping new opportunities. You'll also build our partner FDE track — training and enabling GSI and consulting partners who extend this motion at scale. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who combines deep technical credibility, strong people management, and the judgment to keep engagements scoped tight, delivered fast, and worth repeating. What you'll do Sell - Own the full arc from technical discovery to executive close — partnering with Sales and Account teams to qualify opportunities, leading architecture reviews, surfacing integration complexity and infrastructure constraints, and scoping engagements with enough precision to de-risk delivery before a line of code is written - Build and present proposals that translate ambiguous customer problems into concrete, time-boxed deliverables with clear ROI - Sell the vision and the plan to C-suite stakeholders who need to believe in both the outcome and the team delivering it - Drive deal strategy on strategic accounts; your technical credibility is a direct lever on close rates for six- and seven-figure engagements Deliver - Serve as executive technical sponsor on your region's highest-priority engagements and manage stakeholder relationships from IC engineers to C-suite - Ensure delivery quality across your team's projects: appropriate scoping, milestone tracking, technical standards, and clean handoffs to customer engineering teamsTranslate between business outcomes and technical implementation in both directions - Identify and escalate product gaps, integration friction, and recurring customer pain back to Product and Engineering with enough specificity to drive roadmap decisions - Manage active engagements: escalate on complex builds, coach FDEs on scoping and delivery decisions, and step in directly on accounts where the stakes are highest - Build reusable playbooks that make the broader FDE org more capable over time Manage People - Lead, develop, and scale a team of 6–8 Forward Deployed Engineers working strategic FDE projects - Hire top-tier FDE talent; set clear expectations, technical performance standards, and career growth paths for a team where "excellent" means actually shipping in production - Coach FDEs through the hardest problems in the field — scoping under deal pressure, building alongside senior technical stakeholders, and knowing when to protect scope vs. when to flex - Build and scale the partner FDE track — train, enable, and hold the quality bar for GSI and consulting partners who carry the FDE motion forward at volume You may be a fit if - You have 8+ years of experience leading technical teams that build and ship in production — Forward Deployed Engineering, Solutions Engineering, or a similar function where writing and reviewing code is part of the job - You have experience with software development and coding in Python, Javascript/Typescript - You’ve built and owned AI-native workflows in production, not just prototypes, and have debugged real-world model failures - You can diagnose a complex enterprise engineering environment quickly, identify the highest-leverage intervention, and scope a meaningful engagement - You've built and scaled IC-level technical teams and know what excellence looks like in the field: sharp scoping, clean delivery, and knowledge that stays at the customer long after the engagement closes

The work sits at the meeting point of research and engineering: you'll devise new approaches and be the one to implement them. Your results feed directly into the production training runs that shape our frontier models, in close collaboration with Mistral's researchers, engineers, and security specialists. Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
About the Role
As an AV Operations Specialist, you'll be accountable for how the AV spaces perform, how support requests get resolved, and how events land in the space you're responsible for. This role will help own all areas within the AV landscape. In a given week you might execute a preventative maintenance sweep across a floor of conference rooms, work the support queue and drive a recurring failure to root cause, and then run technical coverage for an all-hands or an executive presentation that evening.
You'll be the regional presence our AV Engineering and Production teams build on — the person who catches problems before users report them, and who turns what you learn on the ground into standards the rest of the team can run from. Your work directly enables the collaboration and transparency that advance our AI safety mission.

Execute preventative maintenance programs and recurring room sweeps on a defined cadence, not only in response to tickets

Systematically isolate faults to a point in the signal chain rather than reaching for reboots and cable swaps
Drive recurring issues to root cause and surface them to AV Engineering as candidates for platform-level or design-level fixes
Contribute to runbooks, standard operating procedures, and knowledge base documentation that other technicians follow
Event Support & Production
Provide technical coverage for live and hybrid events in your office — from small executive presentations and team meetings through to all-hands and company-wide broadcasts
Operate event production systems including audio consoles, video switchers, camera systems, playback, and streaming encoders
Run pre-event readiness: walkthroughs, rehearsals, source checks, gear staging, and failover planning

Communicate status, risk, and resolution to non-technical stakeholders in clear, calm, jargon-free language

Have 8+ years of hands-on experience in AV operations, workplace technology, or technical event support

Thrive in a fast-moving environment where standards are being written rather than inherited

쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 이커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 이커머스 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.
쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저 없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.
